title: Verifying Directly Connected Networks
summary: Investigate how Cisco IOS routers dynamically populate the routing table with directly connected networks (C) and local host routes (L) for both IPv4 and IPv6.
learning_objectives: Explain how directly connected routes (C) and local host routes (L) are installed in the routing table
Interpret the IPv4 routing table using show ip route and filter by code
Interpret the IPv6 routing table using show ipv6 route and explain /128 host route mechanics
Correlate interface operational states (up/up vs down/down) with routing table entries

source.origin: Independently authored educational guide replacing legacy instructor answer key
